entities.summary: Alexey Mikhailovich Fedorychev is businessman, commodity trader, he is owner of two sea terminals in Pivdennyi Port, former owner of the FC Dynamo Moscow and FC Rostov. He is the founder of Fedcominvest and sponsor of AS Monaco Basket.
